core_image.text: 錠を開けるかぎ・問題を解く手がかり
core_image.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 160"><rect width="240" height="160" fill="white"/><g fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="70" cy="80" r="24"/><circle cx="70" cy="80" r="8"/><line x1="94" y1="80" x2="190" y2="80"/><line x1="170" y1="80" x2="170" y2="98"/><line x1="184" y1="80" x2="184" y2="94"/></g><text x="150" y="40" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="black" stroke="none">かぎ・てがかり</text></svg>

etymology: 古い英語 cǣg(かぎ) → かぎ → (問題を開く)手がかり・秘けつ → (形容詞)重要な・(ピアノ・パソコンの)キー

en_definitions.text: a piece of metal for opening a lock; the most important thing for achieving something; a button on a keyboard.

cautions: the key to A=Aのかぎ・秘けつ(to を使う:of ではない)
a key person [factor]=重要人物[要因]

examples.label: かぎ
examples.en: I lost the key to my house.

examples.label: 秘けつ
examples.en: Hard work is the key to success.
